mechanism_narrative: The ERBB2-MET novokine with GS_med linker forces two RTKs with 279 aa ECD asymmetry (ERBB2 ECD=630 aa, MET ECD=909 aa) into proximity, enabling transphosphorylation that synergistically activates SHC1-GRB2-SOS1-RAS-MAPK and GAB1-PI3K-AKT signaling axes. PLCG1 is sterically excluded due to the asymmetric geometry preventing productive docking at the co-clustered ICDs, while GRB7 is also excluded by MET ICD occlusion. The biased output (MAPK↑, AKT↑, PLCγ↓, STAT3 maintained) promotes proliferation, survival, mitochondrial biogenesis, and glucose uptake — a transcriptional program enriched in young skeletal muscle — while suppressing calcium-dependent signaling associated with aged muscle dysfunction. MET is a critical satellite cell activation receptor (PMID:9883724) and ERBB2 is expressed in muscle stem cells (PMID:17123512), making this pair a strong candidate for muscle rejuvenation.
